question: Town A is to the west of Town B. Town C is to the south of Town A. Town D is to the east of Town C. Town E is to the west of Town A. What is the position of Town E with respect to Town C?
solution:
• Town A is to the west of Town B.
 
• Town C is to the south of Town A.
 
• Town D is to the east of Town C.
 
• Town E is to the west of Town A
